Using an older tournament folder?

Select tournament_config.json together with the OJS workbooks. Current workbooks already contain the configuration. TOAST uses the ceremony templates included in this version.

    Choose your files to begin.

    Save changes in Excel before checking again. TOAST reads the saved copy; it cannot see unsaved changes or reliably detect whether Excel is open.

          About this version & licenses

          This standalone file contains its own workbook reader and ceremony templates. It never changes your OJS workbooks. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari. See the release validation notes for browser coverage.
